SELECT source_type, -- 来源类型 settle_date, -- 结算日期 qty, -- 数量 fee, -- 医疗总金额 insur_type, -- 类型代码 insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 count_flag -- 是否计入合计(1计入/0仅明细) FROM (
SELECT '账平' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 a.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 SUM(a.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额 a.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 1 AS count_flag -- 计入合计 FROM ips_dz_biz_bills a WHERE a.zp_flag = 1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保负金额-his正交易' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 b.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(b.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 SUM(b.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额 b.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(b.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 1 AS count_flag -- 计入合计 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills b INNER JOIN ips_dz_biz_bills a ON a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.bill_date <= b.bill_date AND a.medfee_sumamt = -b.medfee_sumamt AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.mdtrt_id = b.mdtrt_id AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') WHERE b.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND b.zp_flag = -1 AND b.INSUTYPE = #{insurType} GROUP BY b.insutype, b.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保负金额-医保正交易' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 b.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(b.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 -SUM(NVL(a.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额(取负) b.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(b.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 1 AS count_flag -- 计入合计 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills b INNER JOIN ips_dz_pay_bills a ON a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.setl_id = b.setl_id AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') WHERE b.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND b.zp_flag = -1 AND b.INSUTYPE = #{insurType} GROUP BY b.insutype, b.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保正金额' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 a.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 SUM(NVL(a.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额 a.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 1 AS count_flag -- 计入合计 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.zp_flag = -1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '金额不等' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 a.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 SUM(a.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额 a.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 0 AS count_flag -- 不计入合计(仅明细) FROM ips_dz_biz_bills a WHERE a.zp_flag = -2 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date ) ORDER BY settle_date, source_type

SELECT source_type, -- 来源类型 settle_date, -- 结算日期 qty, -- 数量 fee, -- 医疗总金额 insur_type, -- 类型代码 insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 count_flag -- 是否计入合计(1计入/0仅明细) FROM (
SELECT '账平' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 a.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 SUM(a.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额 a.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 1 AS count_flag -- 计入合计 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.zp_flag = 1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保负金额' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 a.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 SUM(a.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额 a.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 1 AS count_flag -- 计入合计 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND a.zp_flag = -1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '医保正金额' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 a.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 SUM(NVL(a.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额 a.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 1 AS count_flag -- 计入合计 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.zp_flag = -1 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date UNION ALL
SELECT '金额不等' AS source_type, -- 来源类型 a.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 COUNT(a.setl_id) AS qty, -- 数量 SUM(a.medfee_sumamt) AS fee, -- 医疗总金额 a.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(a.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 0 AS count_flag -- 不计入合计(仅明细) FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.zp_flag = -2 AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND a.insutype = #{insurType} GROUP BY a.insutype, a.bill_date ) ORDER BY settle_date, source_type

SELECT 'HIS业务表' AS table_name, -- 表名 COUNT(t.setl_id) AS qty, -- 总条数 SUM(NVL(t.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee -- 总金额 FROM ips_dz_biz_bills t WHERE t.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND t.insutype = #{insurType} UNION ALL SELECT '医保支付表' AS table_name, -- 表名 COUNT(t.setl_id) AS qty, -- 总条数 SUM(NVL(t.medfee_sumamt, 0)) AS fee -- 总金额 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills t WHERE t.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND t.insutype = #{insurType}

SELECT b.setl_id AS setl_id, -- 结算ID b.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 b.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(b.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 b.medfee_sumamt AS medfee_sumamt -- 医疗总金额(退费,负) FROM ips_dz_pay_bills b WHERE b.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND b.zp_flag = -1 AND b.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.insutype = #{insurType} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_biz_bills a WHERE a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.mdtrt_id = b.mdtrt_id AND a.medfee_sumamt = -b.medfee_sumamt AND a.bill_date <= b.bill_date AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills a WHERE a.setl_id = b.setl_id AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') ) ORDER BY b.setl_id

SELECT diff_side, -- 差异类型 settle_date, -- 结算日期 setl_id, -- 结算ID insur_type, -- 类型代码 insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 pay_zp, pay_zp_name, biz_zp, biz_zp_name, pay_fee, biz_fee, offset_pair, pair_key -- 医保标志/中文,HIS标志/中文,医保金额,HIS金额,自对冲,配对键 FROM ( SELECT '仅医保支付表' AS diff_side, -- 差异类型 p.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 p.setl_id AS setl_id, -- 结算ID p.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(p.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 TO_CHAR(p.zp_flag) AS pay_zp, -- 医保侧账平标志 DECODE(p.zp_flag, 1, '账平', -1, '单边', -2, '金额不等', TO_CHAR(p.zp_flag)) AS pay_zp_name, -- 医保侧标志中文 NULL AS biz_zp, -- HIS侧账平标志(无) NULL AS biz_zp_name, -- HIS侧标志中文(无) p.medfee_sumamt AS pay_fee, -- 医保侧医疗总金额 NULL AS biz_fee, -- HIS侧医疗总金额(无)
CASE WHEN p.is_show = 'true' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills r WHERE r.mdtrt_id = p.mdtrt_id AND r.insutype = p.insutype AND r.psn_no = p.psn_no AND r.medfee_sumamt = -p.medfee_sumamt AND r.setl_id != p.setl_id AND r.is_show = 'true' AND ( (p.medfee_sumamt > 0 AND r.bill_date >= p.bill_date) OR (p.medfee_sumamt < 0 AND r.bill_date <= p.bill_date) ) ) THEN '自对冲' END AS offset_pair, -- 自对冲标记 p.mdtrt_id AS pair_key -- 配对键(就诊号) FROM ips_dz_pay_bills p WHERE p.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND p.insutype = #{insurType} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_biz_bills b WHERE b.setl_id = p.setl_id) UNION ALL SELECT '仅HIS业务表' AS diff_side, -- 差异类型 b.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 b.setl_id AS setl_id, -- 结算ID b.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(b.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 NULL AS pay_zp, -- 医保侧账平标志(无) NULL AS pay_zp_name, -- 医保侧标志中文(无) TO_CHAR(b.zp_flag) AS biz_zp, -- HIS侧账平标志 DECODE(b.zp_flag, 1, '账平', -1, '单边', -2, '金额不等', TO_CHAR(b.zp_flag)) AS biz_zp_name, -- HIS侧标志中文 NULL AS pay_fee, -- 医保侧医疗总金额(无) b.medfee_sumamt AS biz_fee, -- HIS侧医疗总金额 NULL AS offset_pair, -- 自对冲标记(无) NULL AS pair_key -- 配对键(无) FROM ips_dz_biz_bills b WHERE b.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.insutype = #{insurType} AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills p WHERE p.setl_id = b.setl_id) UNION ALL SELECT '账平标志不一致' AS diff_side, -- 差异类型 p.bill_date AS settle_date, -- 结算日期 p.setl_id AS setl_id, -- 结算ID p.insutype AS insur_type, -- 类型代码 DECODE(p.insutype, '310', '职工', '390', '居民', '3101', '异地职工', '3901', '异地居民', '515253', '生育') AS insur_type_name, -- 类型名称 TO_CHAR(p.zp_flag) AS pay_zp, -- 医保侧账平标志 DECODE(p.zp_flag, 1, '账平', -1, '单边', -2, '金额不等', TO_CHAR(p.zp_flag)) AS pay_zp_name, -- 医保侧标志中文 TO_CHAR(b.zp_flag) AS biz_zp, -- HIS侧账平标志 DECODE(b.zp_flag, 1, '账平', -1, '单边', -2, '金额不等', TO_CHAR(b.zp_flag)) AS biz_zp_name, -- HIS侧标志中文 p.medfee_sumamt AS pay_fee, -- 医保侧医疗总金额 b.medfee_sumamt AS biz_fee, -- HIS侧医疗总金额 NULL AS offset_pair, -- 自对冲标记(无) NULL AS pair_key -- 配对键(无) FROM ips_dz_pay_bills p INNER JOIN ips_dz_biz_bills b ON b.setl_id = p.setl_id AND b.insutype = p.insutype WHERE p.bill_date = TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND p.insutype = #{insurType} AND b.zp_flag != p.zp_flag ) ORDER BY CASE diff_side WHEN '仅医保支付表' THEN 1 WHEN '仅HIS业务表' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, setl_id

SELECT insur_type, insur_type_name, -- 类型代码,类型名称 SUM(qty) AS qty, -- 条数 SUM(medfee_sumamt) AS medfee_sumamt, SUM(acct_pay) AS acct_pay, SUM(hlfp_pay) AS hlfp_pay, -- 医疗费总额,个人账户,统筹基金 SUM(cash_pay) AS cash_pay, SUM(cvlserv_pay) AS cvlserv_pay, SUM(hlfes_pay) AS hlfes_pay, -- 现金,公务员补助,企业补充医保 SUM(hlfmi_pay) AS hlfmi_pay, SUM(hlfob_pay) AS hlfob_pay, SUM(maf_pay) AS maf_pay, -- 居民大病,职工大病,医疗救助 SUM(oth_pay) AS oth_pay -- 其他支出 FROM (
) GROUP BY insur_type, insur_type_name ORDER BY insur_type

SELECT insur_type, insur_type_name, category, -- 类型代码,类型名称,类别 SUM(qty) AS qty, -- 条数 SUM(medfee_sumamt) AS medfee_sumamt, SUM(acct_pay) AS acct_pay, SUM(hlfp_pay) AS hlfp_pay, -- 医疗费总额,个人账户,统筹基金 SUM(cash_pay) AS cash_pay, SUM(cvlserv_pay) AS cvlserv_pay, SUM(hlfes_pay) AS hlfes_pay, -- 现金,公务员补助,企业补充医保 SUM(hlfmi_pay) AS hlfmi_pay, SUM(hlfob_pay) AS hlfob_pay, SUM(maf_pay) AS maf_pay, -- 居民大病,职工大病,医疗救助 SUM(oth_pay) AS oth_pay -- 其他支出 FROM (
) GROUP BY insur_type, insur_type_name, category ORDER BY insur_type, CASE category WHEN '账平' THEN 1 WHEN '医保负金额-退费' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

SELECT bill_date, -- 结算日期 SUM(qty) AS qty, -- 条数 SUM(medfee_sumamt) AS medfee_sumamt, SUM(acct_pay) AS acct_pay, SUM(hlfp_pay) AS hlfp_pay, -- 医疗费总额,个人账户,统筹基金 SUM(cash_pay) AS cash_pay, SUM(cvlserv_pay) AS cvlserv_pay, SUM(hlfes_pay) AS hlfes_pay, -- 现金,公务员补助,企业补充医保 SUM(hlfmi_pay) AS hlfmi_pay, SUM(hlfob_pay) AS hlfob_pay, SUM(maf_pay) AS maf_pay, -- 居民大病,职工大病,医疗救助 SUM(oth_pay) AS oth_pay -- 其他支出 FROM (
) WHERE insur_type = #{insurType} GROUP BY bill_date ORDER BY bill_date

SELECT bill_date, category, -- 结算日期,类别 SUM(qty) AS qty, -- 条数 SUM(medfee_sumamt) AS medfee_sumamt, SUM(acct_pay) AS acct_pay, SUM(hlfp_pay) AS hlfp_pay, -- 医疗费总额,个人账户,统筹基金 SUM(cash_pay) AS cash_pay, SUM(cvlserv_pay) AS cvlserv_pay, SUM(hlfes_pay) AS hlfes_pay, -- 现金,公务员补助,企业补充医保 SUM(hlfmi_pay) AS hlfmi_pay, SUM(hlfob_pay) AS hlfob_pay, SUM(maf_pay) AS maf_pay, -- 居民大病,职工大病,医疗救助 SUM(oth_pay) AS oth_pay -- 其他支出 FROM (
) WHERE insur_type = #{insurType} GROUP BY bill_date, category ORDER BY bill_date, CASE category WHEN '账平' THEN 1 WHEN '医保负金额-退费' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

SELECT b.setl_id AS refund_setl_id, -- 退费结算号 b.bill_date AS refund_date, -- 退费日期 b.medfee_sumamt AS refund_fee, -- 退费金额(负) CASE WHEN a.setl_id IS NULL THEN '找不到' WHEN TO_CHAR(a.bill_date, 'yyyy-mm') = TO_CHAR(b.bill_date, 'yyyy-mm') THEN '本月匹配' ELSE '跨月匹配' END AS match_status, -- 匹配状态 a.setl_id AS pos_setl_id, -- 正交易结算号 a.bill_date AS pos_date, -- 正交易日期 TO_CHAR(a.bill_date, 'yyyy-mm') AS pos_month, -- 正交易月份 a.medfee_sumamt AS pos_fee -- 正交易金额 FROM ips_dz_pay_bills b LEFT JOIN ips_dz_biz_bills a ON a.INSUTYPE = b.INSUTYPE AND a.TRAN_TYPE = 1 AND a.mdtrt_id = b.mdtrt_id AND a.medfee_sumamt = -b.medfee_sumamt AND a.bill_date <= b.bill_date AND a.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{prevStart}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') WHERE b.TRAN_TYPE = 2 AND b.zp_flag = -1 AND b.bill_date BETWEEN TO_DATE(#{startDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND TO_DATE(#{endDate}, 'yyyy-mm-dd') AND b.insutype = #{insurType} ORDER BY b.bill_date, b.setl_id
